_comment: Passed via `claude --settings <this-file>` by scripts/launch-topic.sh when the proxy spawns a topic session. Enables telegram@zamua JUST for that session (keep the global ~/.claude/settings.json's telegram disabled so no other claude invocation spawns a competing getUpdates poller), and pre-allows the 4 channel tools because a detached tmux session cannot answer a permission prompt. Pre-allow is used instead of bypassPermissions, which the classifier blocks.
